market_lean_note: At positions labelled market-led or market-blend, the ranking INCORPORATES market consensus (ADP/ECR) alongside our own model — so it is not an independent read on the market at those positions, and a gap between our order and the market's is a smaller, less independent signal there than it would be from a model that ignored the market. The point projections and their ranges are unchanged from the market-blind model, so this is a re-ORDERING of the same numbers, not a re-pricing.
